_comment: Site config: marker roles + optional measured positions + table height. Copy to the device at Android/data/com.example.drones/files/site/default.json (drop the _comment). If positions are omitted, the top-scan derives them from the camera; if every marker has x/y, those measured values are used as ground truth. Units = meters. ArUco IDs come free from the marker pattern — this only supplies role/position/table.
